contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD317-337. Mint is Trier, AD332-333, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows two soldiers and two standards. See RIC VII, p.216, no.539. Obverse shows laurate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TR.P . Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.14g,…
